————————————————————————————————————————————————————————Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d
——————————————Please, make sure that the model will suit to your project by checking the preview images and 3D Model description. If you’re unsure or have doubts, please ask before purchase and your questions will be answered precisely.——————————————

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d

Madeira Streets and Buildings

  - this model is based on real data therefore this is a realistic buildings and streets setup of Madeira, Portugal

  - 5 building groups are setup so that you can add variety to buildings (color materials and/or textures) Groups can be turned off/on

  - .blend

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d

description_text:
Samara Streets and Buildings

  - this model is based on real data therefore this is a realistic buildings and streets setup of Samara, Russia

  - 7 building groups are setup so that you can add variety to buildings (color materials and/or textures) Groups can be turned off/on

  - UV mapped with overlapping UVs

  - this 3D model is/can be licensed (commercial use is fine) under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareALike 2.0 (CC-BY-SA) license

  - buildings and streets data from OpenStreetMap / www.openstreetmap.org

  - .c4d - native format

  - .fbx - v7.1

  - .dae – v1.5

  - .dxf

  - .obj

  - .blend

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d

description_text:
- low-poly 3D models optimised for real-time visualisation, lowpoly look projects, Augmented Reality / Virtual Reality scenes and projects and video games VR/AR (even mobile)

  - 4 vending machines with bottles and cans plus 13 bottles and 12 cans included

  - the bottles and cans are in the machine just as in the preview images so they are ready to use but these ones are embedded into 1 object

  - the 13 bottles and 12 cans are not in the machines (please check the preview images)

  - the front glass is a separated model so that you can freely adjust its transparency in your 3D software

  - all brand names are referring to real products but no real product names were used (no real brand names used)Asabi refers to Asahi , Kitin to Kirin and Pokari Sweet to Pokari Sweat / of course you can replace those brand names with yours if you prefer to

  - translation for Kitin Japanese text - Taste Like Beer / translation for the colourful stars logo Japanese text - Happy Tea / translation for Asabi Japanese text - means nothing just looks good

  - geometry is triangle for all models

  - this package includes native Cinema 4D models which has procedural materials and non-baked textures and also includes baked models(baked models are optimised for exchange formats such .fbx, .obj etc. - if you’re not a C4D user you can also easily use the models as ready to go / no tweaks needed)

  - baked models has Color / AO (ambient occlusion) and Emission textures (emission is for the machines only) and the project also includes the “brand” logos (1000x600 - this size fits perfect for those parts of the models)

  - vending machines baked models have 4K 4096x4096 textures / bottles and cans that are in the machines (embedded as 1 object) have 2048x2048 textures and the separated bottles and cans have 128x128 textures (each) / glass has 1024x1024 Color and Opacity texture

  - UVs are non-overlapping

  - all units and textures named accordingly

  - axis points are set and taken care of

————————————————For UE4 users

  - Unreal Engine 4, after importing the file you might get a “No Smoothing Groups” message.You can ignore that as these models have no smoothing groups or phong tags present due to their low-poly design characteristics.

  - to keep the axis point where it’s originally set, uncheck the option “Transform Vertex to Absolute” on import in UE4, otherwise UE4 will default the axis point to the World centre axis 0,0,0,————————————————

This is a set of concrete blocks. Two types, one with arc shape and one with cone shape. From both types there two separate versions so it is easyer to scatter them accros bigger area. 
This asset was created with photogrametry techniques and it represents realistic 3d mesh and realistic diffuse texture. Photos for photogrametry was taked during overcast day which ensures minimum shadows from local day light. 3D mesh is open and hollow from the bottom part, this is good to keep in mind.
Package contains Hi poly and Low poly objects, dependet on type of usage. This asset is prepared with Vray and Corona shaders for 3Dsmax. This shader is basic with applied diffuse map. There is no reflection, bump or displacement maps included. Package also includes 4k and 8k maps for different type of usage.

- this model is based on real data therefore this is a realistic buildings and streets setup of Irkutsk, Russia

  - 6 building groups are setup so that you can add variety to buildings (color materials and/or textures) Groups can be turned off/on

  - UV mapped with overlapping UVs

  - the model is positioned on a flatv surface (all buildings are on the “floor” - no elevation data included)

  - geometry is polygonal quads and tris

  - model is untextured and renders fast

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model
————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d

Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model
————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d

description_text:
- this model is based on real data therefore this is a realistic buildings and streets setup of Kabul, Afghanistan

  - 6 building groups are setup so that you can add variety to buildings (color materials and/or textures) Groups can be turned off/on

  - UV mapped with overlapping UVs

  - the model is positioned on a flat surface (all buildings are on the “floor” - no elevation data included)

  - geometry is polygonal quads and tris

  - model is untextured and renders fast

If you need a real 3D model of the road network, please note that this 3D model is  compatible with the Kabul Road Network and Streets 3D Model : https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/architectural/street/kabul-road-network-and-streets

  - this 3D model is/can be licensed (commercial use is fine) under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareALike 2.0 (CC-BY-SA) license

  - buildings and streets data from OpenStreetMap / www.openstreetmap.org

Attribution : © OpenStreetMap contributors / CC BY SA 2.0 http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
POINTS/VERTS : 270370POLYGONS : 188501

  - .c4d - native format

  - .fbx - v7.1

  - .dae – v1.5

  - .dxf

  - .obj

  - .blend

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Extra description is to avoid any misunderstanding with the 3D model
————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

  - The “streets” in the title means the area between the buildings. It is not a separate 3D model. There are other models available called “XYZ” Road Network and Streets where the streets are actual 3D models (“XYZ” is just an example and substitutes a real city/area name). You can check the details of every model by watching the preview images. You’ll get exactly that 3D model on purchase which you see on the preview images.

  - Please note, that although the model reflects reality there might have buildings missing if there is no data available for certain parts of the city depending on the degree of data processing. Missing parts might be available later and if it happens an update will come to the model. If you purchased the model all updates come with no extra cost.Also there might be buildings already on the map which they don’t even exist yet due to urban planning projects regarding to the future.Same concept of this point applies to any terrain 3D model if it comes with this model.

  - Those 3D models are compatible with each other (they match by a simple copy and paste command) where the description includes this kind of information. Compatibility added continuously over time. If you need a “XYZ”Streets and Buildings and a “XYZ” Road Network 3D model of the same city/area but they are not compatible, please contact for availability. Usually this kind of request can be prioritised.

  - These models are designed to show and present the city/area in the title in a minimalistic concept. They show a close to exact streets and buildings alignments and building heights (excluding parts where there is no or insufficient data to build 3d geometry) therefore they can be used for many purposes but they are not designed to build ie. high precision urbanscape.

  - These models are not 3D print ready.

  - On purchase, you’ll receive exactly the 3D model that you see on the preview images. Lighting setup isn’t included so you can render the model in your scenes or you can download a free render studio for the city 3D models in .c4d (native format) and .fbx (exchange format). The.c4d is basically ready to render. In the .fbx and/or .dae files the light parameters/details should be setup in your 3D software.

Free render studio download : https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/various/various-models/render-studio-for-cinema-4d
——————————————
Please, make sure that the model will suit to your project by checking the preview images and 3D Model description. If you’re unsure or have doubts, please ask before purchase and your questions will be answered precisely.
——————————————

This model make for game assets and architect scene too.
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.Fidelity is optimal up to a 4K render. Renders have no postprocessing.
INFO ABOUT 3D MODELS:Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

Textures: ( just for the models have textures )

  - High resolution ( ready for 4K rendering ) and named, easy to find and editing.

  - Photoshop File ( Photoshop CC2017 was included for editing textures like you want )

THANKS YOU:Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
Say Hello! – The Olli is a self-driving, electric bus from Local Motors, which is currently on trial ahead of commercial launch in US cities including Las Vegas and Miami in 2017.
 Author of the original design Edgar Andres Sarmiento. (https://www.cgtrader.com/edgar-smf)
 Self-driving
 Olli can drive itself using overlapping sensors like radar, lidar and cameras to see further ahead and react more quickly than a human.
 Olli can carry 12 passengers, and it is initially expected to provide public transport in closed network locations such as campuses and airports, before branching into new functions and locations.
This model is suitable for using in the 3D renderings of architectural visualizations, traffic simulation, games etc. where it doesn't need to use heavy high-polygonal models.
Exterior only!
 Original world size
 Layered PSD 2048*2048
 3DS, FBX, PNG include
 Neatly arranged texture map allows you to put your own livery without complicated graphics software.

Spysteamer, a steampunk sci-fi device. better take care, what you are saying - they are listening.
updated 2021-4-4. - redesigned geometry, new materials.
Steampunk is a retrofuturistic subgenre of science fiction that incorporates technology and aesthetic designs inspired by 19th-century industrial steam-powered machinery. Although its literary origins are sometimes associated with the cyberpunk genre, steampunk works are often set in an alternative history of the Victorian era or the American Wild West, where steam power remains in mainstream use, or in a fantasy world that similarly employs steam power.
A microphone colloquially called a mic is a device – a transducer – that converts sound into an electrical signal. Microphones are used in many applications such as telephones, hearing aids, public address systems for concert halls and public events, motion picture production, live and recorded audio engineering, sound recording, two-way radios, megaphones, radio, and television broadcasting. They are also used in computers for recording voice, speech recognition, VoIP, and for non-acoustic purposes such as ultrasonic sensors or knock sensors.

description_text:
•        Let me present to you high-quality hi-poly smoothable 3D model CHAIRMAN 659 chair. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. • All details of design are recreated most authentically.
•        The well topology of the model allows using any smoothing modifiers. Parts of this model you need to smooth in subdivision level 1 or 2 for the best result.
• Polygon count of non-smooth model is – 9472, and with smooth level 1 - 37512.
•        The model uses 4 materials (2 simple colors and 2 textured): 1 for metal, 1 for plastics and 2 materials with 2 diffuse textures for wood and leather. Material of leather has in addition 1 bump and specular textures for more advanced realism. For the best Bump depth we set Bump Multiplier is 0.4 in Maya Software materials or V-Ray MTL materials for Maya. All textures and materials named correctly.
•        The total of the main textures is 4. Resolutions of all textures are from 1024 to 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive. 
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. Dimensions of real chair is W57cm x D57cm x H87cm (W22,4” x D22,4” x H34,2” inches). All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).

description_text:
Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that.

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++About Vnvisual:We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

  - Unity HDRP ready textures (metalic standard): (base color/MaskMap/Normal).

  - Individual PBR maps: (base color/metalic/Normal/Roughness/AO).

FORMATS

  - .blend

  - .fbx

  - .obj

  - .ply

  - .x3d

In folklore, a mermaid is an aquatic creature with the head and upper body of a female human and the tail of a fish.Mermaids appear in the folklore of many cultures worldwide, including Europe, Asia, and Africa.
In ancient Assyria, the goddess Atargatis transformed herself into a mermaid out of shame for accidentally killing her human lover. Mermaids are sometimes associated with perilous events such as floods, storms, shipwrecks, and drownings. In other folk traditions (or sometimes within the same traditions), they can be benevolent or beneficent, bestowing boons or falling in love with humans.
The male equivalent of the mermaid is the merman, also a familiar figure in folklore and heraldry. Although traditions about and sightings of mermen are less common than those of mermaids, they are generally assumed to co-exist with their female counterparts. The male and the female collectively are sometimes referred to as merfolk or merpeople.
The conception of mermaids in the West may have been influenced by the Sirens of Greek mythology, which were originally half-birdlike, but came to be pictured as half-fishlike in the Christian era. Historical accounts of mermaids, such as those reported by Christopher Columbus during his exploration of the Caribbean, may have been sightings of manatees or similar aquatic mammals. While there is no evidence that mermaids exist outside folklore, reports of mermaid sightings continue to the present day.
Mermaids have been a popular subject of art and literature in recent centuries, such as in Hans Christian Andersen's literary fairy tale The Little Mermaid (1836). description_text:
This is my recreation of Viktor Schauberger's famous invention known as the whorl pipe. The whorl pipe is a water vortex flow pipe that changes the flow characteristics of water using it's unique biomimicry derived geometry.  Its design has been refined through four previous iterations and extensive research into Viktor and Walter's work. This particular tube is designed to be as close to the original as possible. The only surving photo of Viktor's orignial pipe is included above (the black and white image).
This design includes unique characteristics  of the orignal such as the cycloid spiral space curve geometry taken from Kepler's harmonic spiral as well as the hyperbolic funnel, bothof which are fundamental concepts in Schauberger's writings. The design is based on careful analysis of the only surviving photo of the whorl pipe actually used in the successful Stuttgart experiments. It also stays true to the original design principles of Viktor's. I can say with some certainty that this is the closest replication to the original whorl pipe made by Viktor that has EVER been published in a public setting!
This is the most up to date and advanced whorl pipe 3D printing file available today. Based on the Popel experiments, it is believed that water should be spun in a vortex in an egg shaped basin with a rubber hose at the bottom which attaches to the inlet of this pipe for the best results. Experiments to this end are ongiong. *This file is available here for research purposes only. *

description_text:
************************ Short Sunderland **************************
3D model of the british iconic flying boat from the second world war era. PBR Metal-rough workflow used. All maps/texture are included.

  -     Modelled in 3ds Max 2021, textured with Substance painter and then rendered back in Max using V-Ray 5.

  -     V-ray materials used and included.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Short_Sunderland
'The Short S.25 Sunderland is a British flying boat patrol bomber, developed and constructed by Short Brothers for the Royal Air Force (RAF). The aircraft took its service name from the town (latterly, city) and port of Sunderland in North East England.
Developed in parallel with the civilian S.23 Empire flying boat, the flagship of Imperial Airways, the Sunderland was developed specifically to conform to the requirements of British Air Ministry Specification R.2/33 for a long-range patrol/reconnaissance flying boat to serve with the Royal Air Force (RAF). As designed, it served as a successor to the earlier Short Sarafand flying boat. Sharing several similarities with the S.23, it featured a more advanced aerodynamic hull and was outfitted with various offensive and defensive armaments, including machine gun turrets, bombs, aerial mines, and depth charges. The Sunderland was powered by four Bristol Pegasus XVIII radial engines and was outfitted with various detection equipment to aid combat operations, including the Leigh searchlight, the ASV Mark II and ASV Mark III radar units, and an astrodome.'

description_text:
Contains low resolution textures.
In my other products you will find a version ready for 3D printing as well as the German ship Karlsruhe sunk by this plane in 1945
From Wikipedia: he Douglas A-20 Havoc (company designation DB-7) is an American medium bomber, attack aircraft, night intruder, night fighter, and reconnaissance aircraft of World War II. It served with several Allied air forces, principally the United States Army Air Forces (USAAF), the Soviet Air Forces (VVS), Soviet Naval Aviation (AVMF), and the Royal Air Force (RAF) of the United Kingdom. A total of 7,478 aircraft were built, of which more than a third served with Soviet units. It was also used by the air forces of Australia, South Africa, France, and the Netherlands during the war, and by Brazil afterwards.
The model shows the A-20G version torpedo bomber in the Soviet army livery.

description_text:
Holiday resort pack made of summer cottages, two different bars, an ice cream stand, a restaurant with chairs and tables, tennis courts with little details like rackets, tennis balls, water bottles and a high chair. You can also find some green decorated parts with trees, rocks and plants. Pools and sunbeds and a big hotel building with water slides enhance the summer look. Also notice that there are lights in the scene for night renders. Check out the preview images for day and night renders. 
To see the render settings and lighting setup you can check the Blender scene. And in Unity if you want to see the materials just drag and drop the fbx file. Keep in mind that tennis courts have a procedurally created material inside Blender which might not work in Unity and also pools have transparency which might not get transferred to Unity so you may have to put in transparency inside Unity. Feel free to separate objects and use them individually anywhere you like. The renders that I did were done with and HDRI which is not available in the files that I provide.
I hid the lights in the Blender scene so that it won't interfere with the day version of the render. If you want you can cancel the HDRI and AO, hide the sun and sun soft and unhide the lights collection to get the night version.

Title: Enchanted Echoes: A Modern Disney Castle Tale
In the heart of a bustling, modern metropolis, there stood an iconic landmark that had enchanted generations - the Disney Castle. While surrounded by skyscrapers and high-tech wonders, the castle retained its timeless charm and mysteries.
Meet Emma, a young tech-savvy architect who had always been drawn to the allure of the Disney Castle. She grew up hearing tales of its enchanted history and magical secrets. Emma's dream was to restore the castle to its former glory while infusing it with modern technology.
One day, while exploring the castle's archives, Emma discovered a hidden chamber. Inside, she found a holographic message from none other than Walt Disney himself, recorded decades ago. In the message, Walt revealed that the castle held a powerful source of magic that could be harnessed for the betterment of humanity.
Determined to honor Walt's vision, Emma embarked on a journey to restore the castle using cutting-edge technology. She enlisted the help of her brilliant engineer friend, Ethan, and together they formed a team of innovators.
Their first challenge was to preserve the castle's historical architecture while integrating smart systems that would make it sustainable and efficient. They designed solar panels discreetly hidden within the castle's spires and created a cutting-edge waste recycling system.
Inside, they introduced augmented reality tours, allowing visitors to interact with beloved Disney characters in a whole new way. The castle's ballroom became a venue for holographic concerts, featuring Disney classics reimagined by modern artists.
As word spread about the Enchanted Echoes project, a community of Disney enthusiasts and tech aficionados rallied around Emma and Ethan. Together, they hosted hackathons, where young innovators created magic-infused apps and experiences inspired by Disney's legacy.
But restoring the castle's true magic wasn't complete without a touch of the fantastical. Emma and her team discovered a hidden portal within the castle's walls that led to a dimension filled with enchantments. Here, they met Cinderella's fairy godmother, Merlin the magician, and even Mickey Mouse himself, who shared their wisdom and guidance.
With their newfound knowledge, Emma and her team harnessed the castle's magic to make dreams come true. The castle now had the power to temporarily bring beloved Disney characters to life, allowing visitors to experience enchanting adventures.
The revitalized Disney Castle became a symbol of harmonizing tradition and innovation. It attracted visitors from all over the world, who marveled at its blend of history and modernity. Emma's dream had come true, and the castle stood as a testament to the enduring magic of Disney in the digital age.
As for Emma, she knew that her journey had just begun. With the Disney Castle as a beacon of inspiration, she and her team continued to explore the boundaries of technology and imagination, ensuring that the magic would live on for generations to come.

3D Model Grand Army of the Republic Building
The Grand Army of the Republic Building in Detroit is a historic landmark constructed in 1899 as a gathering spot for Civil War veterans. Its Richardsonian Romanesque design includes unique arched windows and a prominent rusticated stone facade. After being abandoned for years, it was renovated and reopened in 2013, now hosting offices, restaurants, and event spaces. The restoration retained many original architectural elements, highlighting its historical importance. Today, the Grand Army of the Republic Building symbolizes Detroit's rich history and continuous revitalization efforts.

description_text:
•         Let me present to you high-quality middle-poly 3D model of table Industriart Greyglass. It is a 3D copy of the real table of Russian manufacturer Industriart that makes industrial design furniture.  This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.... 
•        The well topology of middle-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
•        The model uses 2 materials - 1 for metal and 1 for tabletop glass. Material of metal uses 2 textures (Diffuse and Bump). Bump depth multiplier for metal material need set is 0.1 – 0.2.  Material of tabletop uses 3 textures (Diffuse, Specular and Glossiness).
•        The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
•        The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
•        The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. Dimensions of real table is W114xD80xH76cm (W45”xD31,5”xH30” inches). All parts grouped and named correctly.
•        Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.• In addition we have rendered this model in other scene with HDRI lighting for more visual realism demonstration and a better understanding of materials characteristics. HDRI scene is not included for sale.
•        To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Middle-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.
See also our other models of this manufacturer.

description_text:
Abandoned Bus Mercedes-Benz 608D Caio Carolina I
The concept of the model is to represent a vehicle that has been abandoned for more than 10 years in a region with climate variation. This characteristic is notable when you see the presence of three agents of time: Dust, Mold and Rust. It is a perfect model for barn find scenes or other scenarios.
The model has a well-modeled and textured interior, allowing internal visualization, should you need to add a touch of realism to your project.
The model is actually a PBR, materials that have several layers of textures.
Textures you will find:

  - BaseColor

  - Roughness

  - NormalMap

  - Metallic

  - Opacity

  - Ambient Occlusion

  - HeightMap

There are 5 main materials with their respective UV layers, which are:

  - Glass (2048x2048)

  - BodyPaint (4096x4096)

  - BodyParts (4096x4096)

  - Wheels (2048x2048)

  - Interior (4096x4096)

These respective parts are separated in the mesh in case you need to move an object quickly.
In case you need to use the model in your game project, the mesh is already triangulated.
Low-poly and triangulated model:

  - 48,000 verts

  - 77,000 polys

  - 77,000 tris

the textures are in the .rar file
and the mesh formats are .fbx, .3ds, .obj, .Blend and finally .dae
If you need the model in another format, please contact me. I always give the best support.
I thank everyone who respects my work :) !

description_text:
One wall of old, crumbling, decaying, disintegrating, patched up wooden synagogue in Europe, Lithuania, village of Alanta. Manual retopology preformed, and divided to segments to be used as modular pieces for any kind of building, shag, favela, cabin or just old wooden house construction. The sun was quite strong so the light direction is baked in, but still works quite well, in my opinion. Has 8k PBR textures. I also include textures in .png and LOD’s for separate components of wall. Modularity is not perfect since the building is old and very irregular. Some manual tweaking is required when placing and connecting wall pieces. Could be used in horror game environment, decrepit abandoned village or town scenario, favelas and sheds in fallout4 style or just for some old haunted houses.Made for real time rendering (VR, AR, Game development etc.) but could work for VFX if cavity / bump texture is used as micro displacement.Numbers are given as it is displayed in 3Ds Max.

description_text:
Low Poly model with PBR textures of the World-War 2 era German dive-bomber and ground attack aircraft: the Junkers JU 87.
The model has real-world proportions, is properly oriented and is ready to be used in your desktop, console or mobile game out of the box.
The low poly count allows the model to be used in multiple situations with minimal impact on performance. Small details were baked into the normal map and are not present in the mesh as geometry.
Parts that need to be animated were modeled separately, properly oriented and given clear names: ailerons, elevator, rudder, flaps, landing gears, wheels, propeller and nose.
In addition to these, the JU87 Stuka has long-range fuel tanks, bombs, and underwing gun pods.
The propeller is provided both as a mesh and as a blurred sprite for when the aircraft is airborne.
The model has 3 sets of textures: aircraft (2k resolution), payload (1k resolution), and transparent propeller (512x512 resolution).
There are 5 color maps (or skins) inspired by the real-world counterpart that you can switch between to change the look of your aircraft.
The vehicle model has no interiors, no animations, and no sounds. Only mesh and textures are provided.
The preview images were rendered in Unity 2019.2 in linear color space with a simple post-processing stack (bloom, vignette and SMAA anti-aliasing).
Technical Details

  - Texture Size: 2048x2048 pixels for aircraft, 1024x1024 for payload

  - Poly Count: 5240 tris

  - Vertex Count: 3042 vertices

  - Physically-Based Rendering (PBR): Yes

  - Multiple texture formats are provided to ensure compatibility with a wide range of game and rendering engines: diffuse, normal (both DirectX and OpenGL formats), metallic, smoothness/glossiness, roughness, ambient occlusion.

  - Mesh formats: Blend (native), FBX, OBJ + MTL, unitypackage.

  - UVs were manually unwrapped and carefully organized.

  - Sounds, Animations, Scripts: None, model and texture only.

  - LODs, Cockpit, Interiors, Pilot: None

description_text:
EAMES MOLDED DINING CHAIR - DCW
Design Charles & Ray Eames®, 1946
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Modeled from blueprints and highly accurate.
The model comes with a high-resolution, high-quality wood diffuse, bump, specular maps, allowing for a variety of looks. Two V-Ray wood materials are prepared - dark (oak) and light (bleached ash) veneer. The wood body has two separate sets of UV coordinates, allowing you to change the main material while retaining the plywood border texture on edges. It is possible to use a multi-material plywood: veneer matID 1, edges matID 2.

The Max model (3ds Max 2010) is already optimised and shaded for use with V-Ray (2.0). It includes two different looks for the chair. All elements are named for easy handling and accurately scaled in millimeters. Just merge the model of your choice into your scene, check the map paths, and render!

All other formats includes a fully smoothed hi-poly version of the chair and a low-poly version, which can be smoothed as needed for more details. Non-Max versions do not include material definitions, however the model is carefully UV-mapped, making it easy to re-create the original materials from the provided texture maps.

  - Unreal Engine, Unity & Blender version

  - PBR Materials

  - LowPoly - Game Ready

  - Reasonable poly count

  - Optimized the density of the textures (512px/m)

  - PBR Textures are collected in ORM packages

Available file formats:

  - Unreal Engine 4.22 and later

  - Unity 2022 [Built-in | URP | HDRP]

  - Blender 3.6

  - FBX

  - PNG for Textures

3D Specification:

  - 32 Meshes

  - 20 PBR Material

  - 56 Textures: 4096x4096

  - Textures Maps: BaseColor, Normal, ORM Pack (Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic)

  - Trailer for workers pack - 140-3759 tris

  - Bus stop pack - 103-362 tris

  - Ventilation shaft pack - 28-2181 tris

  - Power Substation - 1804 tris

  - Garage pack - 244-3276 tris

Unreal Engine Specification:

  - Collision: Yes - Handmade + Auto

  - Number of Meshes: 30

  - Supported Development Platforms: PC, Console

  - Supported Target Build Platforms: Windows

Unity Specification:

  - 30 Meshes

  - 21 PBR Materials

  - 1 Shader (for Built-in)

  - 2 Shader Graph (HDRP & URP)

  - 56 Textures

  - Texture Sizes: 4096x4096

  - Textures Maps: BaseColor, Normal, ORM

  - ORM Shader combining maps Ambient Occlusion, Roughness and Metallic into one texture

Origin : Europe, Southern Africa, Western Asia
Environment : along water courses, in pure or mixed
standings; on many types of humid soils

The pollarding creates a very peculiar shape which has become a landmark of the European countryside landscape, especially in the Winter, when the yellow-orange branches stand out above the white snow.

description_text:
Decorative modern leaf pattern lamp cover . the leaf is a tobaco leaf , made in a spherical design so it covers the light, and also creates stunning leafy patterns on the surface its on . A lampshade is a fixture that covers the lightbulb on a lamp to diffuse the light it emits. Lampshades can be made out of a wide variety of materials like paper, glass, fabric or stone. ... A lamp shade also serves to shade human eyes from the direct glare of the light bulbs used to illuminate the lamp.In the late 17th-century in Paris the first public lanterns made their appearance in the centre of the streets. They lit the road during the night. In 1763, the réverbères made their appearance. These were oil lamps with reflectors which were hung above the center of streets. The first public oil lamps in Milan, financed by revenues from a lottery, date from 1785. These were lanterns containing an oil lamp with a number of wicks. A semi-spherical reflector above the flame projected the light downwards, while another reflector, slightly concave and near the flame, served to direct the light laterally.Friedrich Albert Winsor first had the idea of industrializing lighting by producing gas in a factory and distributing it through a pipeline. In the first decades of the 19th century, competing gas companies laid the first gas mains in major cities. But there were fears of explosion and toxicity.The flame fed by the gas coming out of the nozzle was intense, uniform and adjustable, white and brilliant instead of the reddish or orange of oil lamps or candles.The drawbacks of gas lighting were overheating of the air and extremely high oxygen consumption, making it necessary to ventilate the room or isolate the flame by separating the room where the combustion took place from the room being lit. Theatre audiences regularly suffered from headaches and the sulphur and ammonia formed during combustion of the gas ruined furniture.Gas light had to be filtered by opal glass or light fabric shades. Lampshades were no longer used to direct the light but to attenuate it.In 1879, Joseph Swan and Thomas Edison independently developed—combining and perfecting existing elements deriving from the research of Humphry Davy, De Moleyn and Göbel—the incandescent filament electric light bulb.To disguise the intense electric light, lampshades were used. Some were made by Tiffany in colored glass. The great advantage of the electric light bulb was the absence of flame and traces of combustion, thus avoiding all risks of intoxication, explosion or fire. In the beginning, the filament was made of carbonised vegetable fibres, then bamboo fibres and finally metal alloys until, in the early 20th century, the tungsten filament invented in 1904 became established.

description_text:
The earliest tomb paintings in Ancient Egypt, at Nekhen, c. 3500 BC, classified as Naqada, possibly Gerzeh, culture include images of lions, including an image of a human (or deity) flanked by two lions in an upright posture. Among ancient Egyptians, from prehistoric times through well documented records, the war goddess Sekhmet, a lioness,[5] later depicted as woman with a lioness head, was one of their major deities. She was a sun deity as well as a fierce warrior and protector. Usually she was assigned significant roles in the natural environment. The Egyptians held that this sacred lioness was responsible for the annual flooding of the Nile,[5] the most significant contributing factor to the success of the culture. Sometimes with regional differences in names, a lioness deity was the patron and protector of the people, the king, and the land. As the country united, a blending of those deities was assigned to Sekhmet.[citation needed]
Similar regional lioness deities assumed minor roles in the pantheon or, when so significant in a region, continued local religious observance in their own right, such as Bast. Offspring of these deities found niches in the expanding pantheon as well.[citation needed]
During the New Kingdom the Nubian gods Maahes (god of war and protection and the son of Bast) and Dedun (god of incense, hence luxury and wealth) were depicted as lions. Maahes was absorbed into the Egyptian pantheon, and had a temple at the city the invading Greeks called Leontopolis, City of Lions, at the delta in Lower Egypt. His temple was attached to the major temple of his mother, Bast. Dedun was not absorbed into the Ancient Egyptian religion and remained a Nubian deity.[citation needed]
Bast, originally depicted as a lioness and the eye of Ra in the delta region,[5] was the parallel deity to Sekhmet in the southern region. Her nature gradually changed after the unification of the country and Sekhmet prevailed throughout. At that time Bast changed into the goddess of personal protection with different responsibilities, and often was depicted as a very tame lioness or a cat. She is shown to the left atop an alabaster jar that contained precious oils and lotions. The name of the stone probably bears her named because materials sacred to her usually were stored in it..[citation needed]
The sphinx of Ancient Egypt shows the head and shoulders of a human and the body of a lioness. The statues represents Sekhmet, who was the protector of the pharaohs. Later pharaohs were depicted as sphinxes, being thought as the offspring of the deityLions have been widely used in sculpture to provide a sense of majesty and awe, especially on public buildings. Lions were bold creatures and many ancient cities would have an abundance of lion sculptures to show strength in numbers as well.[12][13] This usage dates back to the origin of civilization.[14] There are lions at the entrances of cities and sacred sites from Mesopotamian cultures; notable examples include the Lion Gate of ancient Mycenae in Greece that has two lionesses flanking a column that represents a deity,[15] and the gates in the walls of the Hittite city of Bogazköy, Turkey.[13] The Lion of Menecrates is a funerary statue of a crouching lioness, found near the cenotaph of Menecrates.[citation needed] The lion is by a famous Corinthian sculptor of Archaic Greece, end of the seventh century BC, and is now in the Archaeological Museum of Corfu.

description_text:
This is a city-block worth of buildings which can be used however your imagination desires: it could be a derelict town or a tropical city or town or even a run-down city.
This set includes all three models:Set A: High rise and lower buildings in a square street layout.Set B: A set of buildings in a north-south street layout.Set C: Densely packed buildings in a square street layout.
The city block includes buildings which are viewable from all 4 sides. This means you can rotate the model for a different look.All of the Shanty Town 2: City Block A, B, and C models are built at the same scale, which means you can combine, duplicate, and reposition the models to create an even larger city.
This model also works great with the Shanty Town 1 models.
Product Features:

  - Set A: Vue vob file, with 4,595 polygons.

  - Set B: Vue vob file, with 2,669 polygons.

  - Set C: Vue vob file, with 4,826 polygons.

  - The buildings and fences are separate body parts which can be hidden or shown to suit the needs of your scene.

  - If you look close, you may be able spot opening doors.

  - Duplicate and rotate the city block to create an even larger city.

Textures:

  - One set of texture maps, ranging from 2048x2048 to 4096x4096 pixels, and some with corresponding normal/ bump maps.

  - Large texture maps make it perfect for both close-up and medium-range shots.

All textures are incorporated into the Vue vob file and no textures are included in the zip file.
For use in Vue d`Esprit 2016 and above and it can not be imported into any other software.

description_text:
A ferry is a merchant vessel used to carry passengers, and sometimes vehicles and cargo, across a body of water. A passenger ferry with many stops, such as in Venice, Italy, is sometimes called a water bus or water taxi.
Ferries form a part of the public transport systems of many waterside cities and islands, allowing direct transit between points at a capital cost much lower than bridges or tunnels. Ship connections of much larger distances (such as over long distances in water bodies like the Mediterranean Sea) may also be called ferry services, especially if they carry vehicles.

description_text:
Detailed model made based on one of the drawings of Sant'Elia.
The model represents one of the draws made by Antonio Sant'Elia in 1914 for the Cittá Nuova New city. In this case it is a terraced building with external elevators and it was part of the exhibition of the Nuove Tendeze group, of wich he was a member. Sant'Elia died at 1916 when he was only twenty eight years old, however his drawings influenced many architects and designers along the time.
All objects have his axis at the same place and situated at the origin point of Z.

description_text:
A corn crib or corncrib is a type of granary used to dry and store corn.

After the harvest, corn, still on the cob, is placed in the crib either with or without the husk. The typical corn crib had slats in its walls. These slatted sides of the corn crib allow air to circulate through the corn, both allowing it to dry initially and helping it to stay dry. The slats expose the corn to pests, so corn cribs are elevated above the ground beyond the reach of rodents.

Linzer Stadion is a multi-purpose stadium in Linz, Austria. It is the home venue for FC Blau-Weiß Linz and Linzer Athletik Sport Klub at European competitions. The available formats are;

  - *.fbx (Autodesk FBX)

  - *.obj (Wavefront)

The model includes polygons, textures and light positions.

description_text:
Padel is typically played in doubles on an enclosed court roughly 25% smaller than the size of a tennis court. Scoring is the same as normal tennis and the balls used are similar but with a little less pressure. The main differences are that the court has walls and the balls can be played off them in a similar way as in the game of squash and that solid, stringless bats are used. The height of the ball being served must be at or below the waist level. 
Padel rules states that the playing field should be a rectangle 10 metres (32 ft 10 in) wide (back wall) and 20 metres (65 ft 7 in) long (side wall) (with a 0.5% tolerance), enclosed by walls. At the middle of the playing field there will be a net dividing the court in two, the net has a maximum height of 88 cm in the center raising to 92 centimetres (36 in) at sides (with a 0.5 centimetres (1⁄5 in) tolerance).
The superstructure is made from connecting 3m high x 2m wide panels, with an additional 1m mesh height over the glass back walls (10m walls). This additional 1m height is continued for 2m from each corner over the side walls also. This means that the back walls and service corners are actually 4m in height, with the remaining side walls are 3m in height.
Glass panels make up the back walls and service side walls (closest 2 side panels to back walls), whilst metal mesh panels occupy the sides.
The service lines are placed 3 metres (9 ft 10 in) before the back wall and there will be also another line in middle that divides the central rectangle in half. All lines have a 5-centimetre (2 in) width and should be clearly visible.
The minimum height between the playing field and an obstacle (for e.g. the ceiling) is 6 metres (19 ft 8 in).

Its look guarantees a real stadium feeling:With its 2 tiers and 17 candy tiles, there is plenty of space for lots of snacking fun.LED tubes (e.g. this one: https://www.amazon.de/dp/B08S3QLW5M?psc=1&ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_product_details) can be inserted into the advertising boards in both tiers and light up the engraved lettering like the Infinity screens in the NFL stadium.The components with team imprints (end zone and upper level band lettering) are also available in 32 different designs, depending on team preference.The playing field is designed in great detail and a cell phone holder serves as a stadium screen during the game.The tiles can be easily removed from the construction, refilled and replaced at any time during the game.The second rank is optional and can also be omitted if desired.Let's goooooo!

description_text:

This animation pack has been designed to be the most complete set of 3D animations on the Volley-Ball theme. The entire motion capture was performed by Guillaume Fenot, a long time volleyball player. Optimization & Usability

  - Suitable for both beginners and professional developers

Included Files

  - .blend file (fully editable source file)

  - Full set of PBR textures

Use Cases

  - Strategy or chess-based games

  - Fantasy / medieval environments

  - Cinematic animations and renders

  - Level design prototypes

description_text:
This kit contains pieces of sidewalk and roads with different type of road markings, that will allow you to create a wide variety of streets with endless number of lane. It also includes presets, that will help you build quickly your city streets.
-The size is based on real world scale (Unit centimeter).
-This product was created in Maya 2014. Preview render made with Mental ray.
-File Formats included: ma, mb, fbx and obj.
- 2048x2048 Jpeg textures (Diffuse, Specular, Bump).
-Pdf Catalog included, so you can easily grab the piece you want.
- Bonus textures included, so you can create more variety in the sidewalks.
*To get the textures loading properly, place all the files (textures and models) in the same folder (no subfolder).

[{"score": 1, "comment": "You sure get a lot of buildings and texture resources here for the price.  I can't really complain, even if some of the buildings are somewhat imperfect.  Objects are grouped in a smart manner making it easy to export something or everything into the software of your choice.
If you need props for an advertisement, video, city scene, or something else similar, you will be in good shape here as there is a lot to choose from here.
 A few of the buildings were not 100% perfectly plumb-level-square, and some doors were a bit larger than others.  This isn't an issue for those handy in a modeling program, and most of the models are solid and usable as-is.
Over-all?  You can't beat it for the price, especially if you got it on sale.  Even for full price, you still get A LOT of bang for your buck.  Just keep in mind for real-time 3D use, you'll want to either use Vulkan or DX12 multi-threaded rendering pipelines for your game render engine, or sit tight for a while doing lots of UV sewing (they have scripts for this out there, that make short work of that).  Again, using this in DX12 or Vulkan with multi-threaded draw call pipelines you should be OK, but if you use this on DX11 and below, you'll have rather high CPU use on one core as the rendering engine processes a lot of draw calls as many of the UV faces aren't sewn together (which reduces draw calls when sewn).  Of course, if that was already done, you'd be paying a lot more for this.
The textures are a good balance between space-saving moderate-resolution textures and high detailed stuff.  Don't get me wrong, as it's not next-gen level of detail, but it's sufficient for it's purpose and won't chew VRAM more than required, which is a BIG plus.
Any experienced modeler will be able to solve either texture 'issues' (personal or project preference, or perhaps using preferred language of choice on store-fronts etc) and most of the folks who do model by now usually have a UV assist script pack that will make short work of sewing UV's.
To the author, thank-you very kindly for making such a detailed and populated city scene, as I have no complaints for the price.  This model set keeps my city from becoming bland looking and same-y all over by adding fresh ideas and different architecture.
Everything in this model is SAFE FOR WORK, for those looking at this from a commercial aspect.  Using this in a render (animated or not) will work out quite nicely, even if it's tiled many times as the way this is put together it's easy to piecemeal and tile things however you want to prevent excessive repetition.  This is a big plus and time saver.
Keep up the good AFFORDABLE work, as if I can't afford it, it's no good for my game-mod project anyway.  So all in all I am a happy customer, not upset int he least  :)", "date": "2022-02-20"}, {"score": 1, "comment": "Complimenti, bellissimo!!!", "date": "2021-02-09"}, {"score": 1, "comment": "", "date": "2022-05-25"}]

Keep your citizens of the future safe with this near-future style railing.Ideal for city sidewalks, the meshes are designed to be configured into any pattern you need. Includes both materials (Blender version only) and 4k textures in two minor variants of wear. Textures include a Diffuse/Albedo Image, a Roughness Map, a Metallic Map, and an Ambient Occulssion Map.Inside the panel handle there is a plane to add internal lighting to the panel.
Intended Usage Case:  Animation, High Quality Art/VFX
Pole dimensions are 1.04ft x 1.04ft x 4.6ft (31.7cm x 31.7cm x 140cm).Panel dimensions are 0.5ft x 6.49ft x 4.25ft (15cm x 198cm x 130cm).[Both in X, Y, Z respectively.]

All are included in .Blend file.Parts are packed individually for all other formats.
UV Unwrapped: Yes (Blender Smart UV Projection)
Textures: Yes
Rigged: No
Total Bones: None
Note: Does include some Ngons!

description_text:
The Bradbury Building is an architectural landmark located at 304 Broadway at West 3rd Street in downtown Los Angeles, California. Built in 1893, the building was commissioned by Los Angeles gold-mining millionaire Lewis L. Bradbury and constructed by draftsman George Wyman from the original design by Sumner Hunt. It appears in many works of fiction and has been the site of many movie and television shoots and music videos.
The building was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1971, and was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1977, one of only four office buildings in Los Angeles to be so honored. It was also designated a landmark by the Los Angeles Cultural Heritage Commission and is the city's oldest landmarked building.
The building's undistinguished exterior facade of brown brick, sandstone and terra cotta detailing was designed in the commercial vernacular Italian Renaissance Revival style current at the time. It is the interior that is the most notable part of the building.
The Bradbury Building is featured prominently as a setting in films, television, and literature – particularly in the science fiction genre. Most notably, the building is the setting for both the climactic rooftop scene of Blade Runner (1982), as well as the set of the character J. F. Sebastian's apartment in which much of the film's story unfolds.

description_text:
The Astra modelo 400 was a Spanish service pistol produced by weapons manufacturer Astra-Unceta y Cia SA. as a replacement for the Campo-Giro 1913/1916, which had also been chambered in 9mm Largo. It was the standard issue sidearm in the Spanish Army during the Spanish Civil War and also saw service in Germany during World War II.

The Astra 400 is heavy compared to many contemporary service pistols of the time like the Tokarev TT-33 but is similar in weight and length to the Colt 1911. The Astra 400 was designed to be safe to fire with a simple blowback action unaided by any breech-locking devices. This is only possible with a heavy slide and strong recoil spring. It was fitted with an internal hammer which was considered very hard to . The pistol also featured grooved finger grips and left sided trigger catch behind the trigger guard. The original design was chambered in 9mm Largo, but later variants would be chambered differently to better fulfill different military needs.

Rigged parts:
Slider
Barrel
Safety
Trigger
Magazine
Shell
Silencer

Includes textures for gun and bullet, at 1024x1024 pixels.
